capabilities: Auto-rename untitled notes after typing stops
Generate Japanese titles from note text via Gemini or Claude
Batch-title all untitled notes with confirmation
Exclude folders and individual notes from titling
extras: API keys are stored per device in Obsidian's Keychain and never synced, so each device must be set up once. Note text (up to about 8,000 characters, without front matter, comments or embedded images) is sent to the chosen AI service only when a title is generated. Gemini has a free tier that may use submitted content to improve Google's products; Claude requires paid credits. Installation is via BRAT until community approval.
motivation: The author wanted to stop thinking up a file name for each new note.
problem: New notes stay named 無題のファイル or Untitled, so the user has to invent a filename for every note by hand.

relations.evidence: Anthropic Claude API (api.anthropic.com). No other network requests are made.

requires.name: Google AI Studio or Anthropic Console account

summary: Plugin that renames untitled notes with AI-generated Japanese titles based on note content, using Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude.
